title: Acceptance criteria
description: The committed basis on which the goods or work of an order are accepted. Elective and NEVER default-on: composed when the parties need the acceptance basis as shared reference — what an inspection service attests against, and what the buyer's receipt references. Commits the acceptance basis (the external standard, specification, or purchase-order reference is the source of truth; this clause references it) and optionally affixes the full criteria document by content hash. Inspection and receipt outcomes are filed as runtime attestations at stage 1 — one attestation per inspection or acceptance event, by whichever party performed it. Whether the goods met the committed basis is what the attested outcomes evidence; the kernel's resolution stays the buyer's sovereign act and is never conditioned on this clause.

fields.name: acceptanceBasis
fields.label: Acceptance basis
fields.description: Free-form reference to the standard, specification, or document the goods must meet (e.g. "AQL 2.5 per ISO 2859-1 against PO 4711", "phytosanitary certificate per ISPM 12") — any basis, existing or future; the protocol takes no closed list.

fields.name: criteriaHash
fields.label: Criteria document hash
fields.description: Optional keccak256 content hash affixing the full criteria document to the agreement.

fields.name: criteriaUri
fields.label: Criteria document
fields.description: Optional locator for the affixed criteria document the hash above anchors.

1.name: outcome
1.label: Outcome
1.description: The inspection or acceptance outcome against the committed basis. Reservations ride the evidence reference.

1.name: occurredAt
1.label: Occurred at
1.description: When the inspection or acceptance was performed.

1.name: evidenceUri
1.label: Inspection evidence
1.description: Optional reference to the inspection report or acceptance record.
